question: Which shop and which office decide that a reward redemption was ordered, fulfilled or refunded, and may a refund return the full credit amount or only the amount the shop refunded?
decision: An organization administrator binds and verifies its own Shopify shop and webhook secret; each inbound event must be tied to the verified tenant and shop, signature-checked, replay-protected and idempotent. Apply only actually refunded amounts (including partial refunds and tax/shipping treatment as policy defines) to the corresponding original redemption, never credit more than originally debited. A disconnected or unverified shop cannot issue or reverse credits.
originalProposedDecision: Each org binds its own Shopify shop domain and signing secret; webhooks are verified per shop. A refund returns only the amount the shop refunded.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
